item.title: Unit Testing vs Integration Testing vs System Testing in Java
item.description: “We have 90% test coverage” means nothing if 90% of your tests are mocking away the parts that matter. A codebase full of unit tests that mock every dependency can have excellent coverage numbers while completely missing bugs that manifest when real components interact. Understanding the difference between unit tests, integration tests, and system tests — and when to use each — is the foundation of a test suite that actually finds bugs.
